name: codex-task-gate
description: A Codex pre-coding gate that inspects first, treats proposed tech as unverified unless it is an explicit constraint, shrinks broad requests to a minimum sufficient working path, and recovers a lower-automation real completion when the preferred path is blocked.

interface.shortDescription: Gate coding work to a minimum sufficient path
interface.longDescription: A lightweight Codex skill that stops incomplete wording from becoming a large codebase. It inspects the repo and authoritative sources first, treats user-named technologies as proposals unless they are explicit constraints, defaults broad requests to a runnable, verifiable path, and lowers automation before handing a blocked task back to the user.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-task-gate. Shrink this to a minimum sufficient working path.
